description: UI helper functions for mapping chess.js board state to UI rendering concerns, including mapping pieces to unicode, generating file and rank labels, square notation, and determining light/dark squares.

methods.name: pieceToUnicode
methods.description: Convert a chess.js piece ({type, color}) to a unicode symbol string.

methods.name: files
methods.description: Returns an array of files (columns) from 'a' to 'h'.

methods.name: ranks
methods.description: Returns an array of ranks (rows) from 8 to 1.

methods.name: squareAt
methods.description: Builds algebraic square notation like 'e4' from file and rank.

methods.name: isLightSquare
methods.description: Determines if a square should be light-colored based on file and rank indices.
